# Introduction

This lab provides the code to replicate the following [NYT Graphic](https://archive.nytimes.com/www.nytimes.com/interactive/2013/03/29/sports/baseball/Strikeouts-Are-Still-Soaring.html?_r=0&ref=baseball) using the core R `graphics` package. 

<br>

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DS4PS/cpp-526-fall-2019/master/LABS/images/strikeouts.png)

<br>
<br>

# Lahman Data

These baseball data come from the `Lahman` package, which contains `Teams` - 
seasonal stats for each team.

<br>

```{r}

library(Lahman)
data(Teams)                               # Load 'Teams' dataset

```

<br>

## Previewing Teams Data

We can view the first few rows of `Teams` with function `head()`.

<br>

```{r}

head(Teams)

```

<br>

## Preprocessing

Summary statistics required for this graphic are calculated as follows. 

**Note:** *The years in the dataset exceed the years shown in the NYT graphic and require filtering or plotting limits.*

<br>

```{r}

ave.so <- Teams$SO / Teams$G                      # Calculating average strikeouts per game
year <- Teams$yearID                              # Extracting a vector of years per team

ave.so.min <- min(ave.so, na.rm = TRUE)
ave.so.max <- max(ave.so, na.rm = TRUE)           # Minimum and maximum x-axis limits

league.ave <- tapply(X = ave.so, 
                     INDEX = as.factor(year), 
                     FUN = "mean", 
                     na.rm = TRUE)                # Calculating league strikeout average/season

league.year <- as.numeric(names(league.ave))      # Ensuring years are numeric, not text

```

<br>
<br>

# Replication

The following recreates the NYT graphic as closely as possible.

**Note:** *You may replicate the graphic step-by-step or in a single code chunk.*

<br>

## 1. Average Strike-Outs by Year

The following establishes plot dimensions and specifies x- and y-axis variables. 

```{r}

plot.new()

plot.window(xlim = c(1900, 2012), 
            ylim = c(ave.so.min, 
                     ave.so.max))   # Specify dimensions

points(x = year, 
       y = ave.so)                  # Create scatterplot


```

<br>
<br>

## 2. Point Color, Size, & Shape

The following additional code builds on the previous plot to specify point color, size, and shape.

```{r}

plot.new()

plot.window(xlim = c(1900, 2012),   # Specify x-axis limits 
            ylim = c(ave.so.min, 
                     ave.so.max))   # Specify y-axis limits

points(x = year, 
       y = ave.so,
       col = "gray85",              # Color
       pch = 16,                    # Shape
       cex = 0.75)                  # Size


```

<br>
<br>

## 3. Full Replication

The following code replicates the NYT graphic in its entirety.

```{r}
library(dplyr)

league.ave <- data.frame(year, ave.so) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarize(ave.so = mean(ave.so, na.rm = TRUE))

```


```{r}

par(mar = c(2,1,3,4), 
    oma = c(0,0,0,0))

plot.new()


plot.window(xlim = c(1900, 2012),   # Specify x-axis limits 
            ylim = c(ave.so.min, ave.so.max), # Specify y-axis limits
            main = 'type = "o"',
            xlab="",
            ylab="",
            col.axis = "gray60",
           frame.plot = F)  
#Title

text(x= 1896, y = 10, 
     labels = "Strikeouts on the Rise",
     adj= 0, font = 1, cex = 1.8)

#Subtitle
text(x = 1896, y = 9.5,
     labels = "There were more strikeouts in 2012 than at any other time in major league history.",
      adj = 0,font = 1, cex = 0.9, col = "gray40")

abline(h = seq(from = 0, to = 9, by = 1),
      col = "gray70",
      lty = 2, # dashed
      lwd = 0.5)

keep <- ave.so >= 2
points(x = year[keep], 
       y = ave.so[keep],
       col = "gray85",              # Color
       pch = 16,                    # Shape
       cex = 0.75)                  # Size


# Bold portion
text(x = 1896, y = 9.2, 
     labels = "Strikeouts per game per team", 
     adj = 0, font = 2, cex = 0.9)
# Regular portion, positioned right after the bold text ends
bold.width <- strwidth("Strikeouts per game per team    ", cex = 0.9)

text(x = 1896 + bold.width, y = 9.2, labels = "(by batters)", 
     adj = 0, font = 1, cex = 0.9, col = "gray50")

# Legend

legend.x <-1896
legend.y <- 8.75

segments(x0 = legend.x, x1 = legend.x + 4, y0 = legend.y, y1 = legend.y, 
         col = "steelblue4", lwd = 1, xpd = NA)

points(x = c(legend.x,legend.x + 4), y=c(legend.y, legend.y), col = "steelblue4", pch = 16, cex = 0.9)

text(x = legend.x + 9, y = legend.y, labels = "League Average", col = "steelblue4", adj = 0.2, cex = 0.8, font = 1)

#Dropdown Label
dropdown.x <-1901
dropdown.y <- 8.3
box.width <- 15
box.height <- 0.4
dropdown.legend.x <- legend.x
dropdown.legend.y <- legend.y

#outline
rect(xleft = dropdown.x, xright = dropdown.x +box.width, 
     ybottom = dropdown.y - box.height/2, ytop = dropdown.y + box.height/2, border = "gray75", col = "NA", lwd = 1.5, xpd = NA)

#text
text(x=dropdown.x + 0.5, y = dropdown.y, 
     labels = "Choose a team",
     col = "orange", adj = 0, cex = 0.75, font = 1, xpd = NA)

text(dropdown.x + box.width -1, y = dropdown.y, 
     labels = "\u25BC", 
     col = "orange", cex = 0.6, xpd = NA)

segments(x0 = dropdown.x - 5, x1 = dropdown.x - 1, 
         y0 = dropdown.y, y1 = dropdown.y, 
         col = "orange", lwd = 1, xpd = NA)

points(x = c(dropdown.x - 5, dropdown.x - 1), 
       y = c(dropdown.y, dropdown.y), 
       col = "orange", pch = 16, cex = 0.9)
# X axis, by decade

axis(side = 1, lwd = 1, at = seq(from = 1890, to = 2020, by = 10))

# Y axis 

axis(side = 4, 
     lwd = 0, 
     las = 1, 
     col.axis = "gray80",
     at = seq(from = 0, to = 9, by = 1), font.axis = 2)


# League Trendline

league.avg <- aggregate(ave.so ~ year, 
                    data = data.frame(year = year[keep], ave.so = ave.so[keep]), 
                    FUN = mean, na.rm = TRUE)

league.avg <- league.avg[league.avg$ave.so >= 1, ]

# Plotting Code

lines(x = league.avg$year, y = league.avg$ave.so, col = "steelblue4", lwd = 2)

keep <- ave.so >= 1

points(x = league.avg$year, y = league.avg$ave.so, col = "steelblue4", pch = 16, cex = 1)


# "Event years" 

events <- c(1918, 1945, 1963, 1969, 1973, 2007)
label.y <- c(1.3, 1.8, 2.9, 8, 1.8, 3.9)
event.labels <- c("U.S. enters\nWorld War I.",
            "Players return\nfrom World War II.",
            "Strike zone enlarged\nfrom 1963-68.",
            "Pitching had become so dominant\nin the 1960s   that the mound\nwas lowered in 1969.","Designated hitter rule\n took effect.", "Mitchell report\non steroids.")

#Define label heights

event.y <- league.avg$ave.so[match(events,league.avg$year)]

segments(x0 = events, x1 = events,      
         y0 = event.y, y1 = label.y,
         col = "gray50", lty = 1, lwd = 0.75)

text(x = events, y = label.y, labels = event.labels, 
     cex = 0.85, col = "gray70", 
     pos = c(1,1,1,3,1,1))

# "Major points" 

highlight.years <- c(1924, 2012)
highlight.y <- league.avg$ave.so[match(highlight.years, league.avg$year)]

points(x = highlight.years, y = highlight.y, pch = 1, cex = 1.8, col = "steelblue4")

text(x = 1924, y = 2.7, labels = "2.7", pos = 1, offset = .75,  cex = 1.4, col = "steelblue4", font = 2)
text(x = 2010, y = 7.5, labels = "7.5", pos = 3, offset = .75,  cex = 1.4, col = "steelblue4", font = 2)

# "League average" sub-levels
text(x = 1924, y = 2.1, labels = "League average\n1924", 
     cex = 0.7, col = "black", pos = 1, font = 2, offset = 0.15)
text(x = 2010, y = 7.5, labels = "2012\nLeague average", 
     cex = 0.7, col = "black", pos = 3, font = 2, offset = 1.8)

```
